{"reason":"Broaden the demand branch to accept market-signal mismatches or forecast biases above 0.05. This corrects the listed unknown→demand failures, including biases of 0.065/0.067/0.081 and five mismatch rows, while preserving supplier-delay precedence; accuracy and recovered amount should rise from v1’s 0.708 accuracy and 23 unknowns.","source":"(define (claim-root-cause expedite-event)
  (cond
    ((and (edi-increase? expedite-event)
          (supplier-lead-time-miss? expedite-event))
     'supplier-delay)
    ((or (market-signal-mismatch? expedite-event)
         (and (forecast-bias? expedite-event)
              (> (bias-amount expedite-event) 0.05)))
     'demand-forecast-error)
    (else 'unknown)))"}
